title: Autonomous Mode
sub: Leave what repeats to the squad. You set the limits.

resps.title: Responsibilities
resps.sub: what the squad does on its own, in cycles

empty.title: Nothing delegated yet.
empty.text: Start with what repeats most in your week. The squad talks it through with you, shows you what was agreed, and only turns it on after your OK.

more.title: What else the squad can take on
more.sub: every delegation starts with a conversation

plan.title: Plan my content every week
plan.text: Topics, captions, and artwork, ready for you to approve.

posts.title: Prepare posts every Monday
posts.text: The week’s pieces with captions, for you to review.

opp.title: Let me know when an opportunity comes up
opp.text: Dates, the neighborhood, competitors, and your numbers.

reviews.title: Reply to Google reviews
reviews.text: Replies in {business}’s tone, for you to approve.

levels.title: How autonomy works
levels.sub: three levels, each with its own limit

an.d: Researches, tracks, and interprets information, only in the accounts you’ve connected.

pr.d: Creates drafts, plans, pieces, and reports every cycle, without you asking again.
pr.w: Does it on its own · you approve what goes out

ex.d: Publishing, sending messages, changing campaigns, and spending only happen with specific authorization for each action.

levels.foot: Approving content doesn’t authorize publishing, sending messages, changing campaigns, or spending. Each of these actions needs its own authorization.

next.title: Upcoming runs
next.empty: Nothing scheduled. When you delegate something, the runs show up here.

history.title: Run history
history.empty: Every run is logged here, with what was done, what failed, and the work it created.
